quotes.text: AddrBookDataRow formats multiple email, phone, and postal address values for a single table cell. For vCard contacts it uses prioritized values such as getAllValuesSorted("tel") and getAllValuesSorted("adr"); for legacy cards it reads Work/Home and other fields. It removes empty entries and joins with Services.intl.ListFormat. The xpcshell test adds, reprioritizes, and removes multiple values, checking the displayed text after each update. Current code still has these branches.
